index_definitions.formdev_record_created: CREATE INDEX formdev_record_created ON public.formdev_record USING btree (form_id, created_at DESC, record_id DESC)
index_definitions.formdev_record_index_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX formdev_record_index_pkey ON public.formdev_record_index USING btree (record_id, field_id)
index_definitions.formdev_record_ingest: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX formdev_record_ingest ON public.formdev_record USING btree (form_id, ingest_seq)
index_definitions.formdev_record_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX formdev_record_pkey ON public.formdev_record USING btree (record_id)
index_definitions.formdev_record_recent: CREATE INDEX formdev_record_recent ON public.formdev_record USING btree (form_id, updated_at DESC, record_id DESC)
index_definitions.formdev_record_status_recent: CREATE INDEX formdev_record_status_recent ON public.formdev_record USING btree (form_id, status, updated_at DESC, record_id DESC)
index_definitions.formdev_record_subject: CREATE INDEX formdev_record_subject ON public.formdev_record USING btree (form_id, subject_id, created_at DESC, record_id DESC) WHERE (subject_id IS NOT NULL)
index_definitions.formdev_ri_num_live: CREATE INDEX formdev_ri_num_live ON public.formdev_record_index USING btree (form_id, field_id, value_num, updated_at DESC, record_id DESC) WHERE ((value_num IS NOT NULL) AND (status <> 'deleted'::text))
index_definitions.formdev_ri_text_live: CREATE INDEX formdev_ri_text_live ON public.formdev_record_index USING btree (form_id, field_id, value_text, updated_at DESC, record_id DESC) WHERE ((value_text IS NOT NULL) AND (status <> 'deleted'::text))

constraints.formdev_record_index_record_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (record_id) REFERENCES formdev_record(record_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
